lemma: LEMMA L-block (vertex block of the homogeneous GF(3) kernel): for T = {t in GF(3)^3 : t1+t2+t3 = 0}, every nonzero t in T has weight >= 2, hence any two nonzero vectors of T have intersecting supports. Proof: wt(t)=1 forces the coordinate sum to be a nonzero element of GF(3), contradicting t in T; two supports of size >= 2 in a 3-set have total size >= 4 > 3, so they meet. This is condition (L) of Thm 4.1 for the coordinate-blocked kernel; it does not by itself discharge G0001.
